newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down as selling continues.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down as selling continues.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down amid a continuous bearish trend triggered by retail selling for cash to bid for initial public offerings (IPOs) and repayment of bank loans, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index fell 30.16 points or 2.8 percent at 1,044.08 on a turnover of 43.8 million taka. Losers led gainers by 99 to 20.
Brokers said there were about 250 million taka worth of IPOs on offer. Besides, investors are under pressure to repay bank loans worth some 500 million taka taken about against their shares.
"Buyers stayed on the sidelines awaiting a further fall in share prices before making fresh commitments," said one broker.
Leasing company IDLC lost 62 taka to 2,002, Singer Bangladesh dropped 144 to 5,653 and Apex Foods fell 108 to 1,926. ($1 = 43.65 taka)
